verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a format and library for packaging agent instructions, scripts, and resources as SKILL.md folders. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is an auth and identity capability of the services an agent calls, which falls outside what a skill-packaging standard does. Nothing in the pack shows Skills issuing credentials; subagent tool permissions belong to Claude Code, not to Skills, and are not API credential issuance.
